payload.title: Gateway live WS disconnect (logout + admin) + inspect admin-token auth
payload.description: Two small TODOs: (1) /auth/logout + admin disconnect do not live-close the WS (auth_routes.rs:364, routes/admin.rs:353 returns disconnected:0) — add gateway.close_session(token). (2) routes/inspect.rs accepts any session for the inspect tier (TODO(FR-246)); add admin-token inspect auth.
